Create ONE handsome Dwarven married couple's double bed: a single continuous broad oak bedframe, one shared mattress and teal quilt, exactly two side-by-side ivory pillows at the head, thick carved oak headboard and footboard with restrained brass geometric Celtic/Nordic joinery. Genuine transparent alpha, no floor, no room, no people, no writing, no scene, no cast shadow outside silhouette. Do not make two separate beds pushed together. Do not include other furniture.
prompts.households: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production sprite atlas of nine original Dwarven household facades for the 2D game The Stellar Holds. Portrait canvas, a precise 3 columns by 3 rows grid with generous transparent gutters. Each cell contains ONE complete tall building frontage, same front-facing slightly elevated orthographic view, horizontal lintels and threshold, NO diagonal/isometric rotation. Each frontage is roughly two-thirds as wide as tall, one ordinary wooden entrance at bottom CENTER, exactly aligned low threshold; stout inhabitable adult scale, two storeys, window openings above. These are inhabited apartments carved INTO the walls of a monumental subterranean mountain hold, not detached outdoor cottages: thick load-bearing stone piers, massive carved lintels, deep recessed doorways and integrated flat vault coping. No sky, no grass, no outdoor pitched roofs. All nine must differ clearly in silhouette, window arrangement, carved trim and domestic details, never nine recolors of one design. Row 1 Crownward: dignified pale granite homes, ancestral geometric reliefs, restrained brass, blue-teal banners, one arched paired-window front, one narrow stepped stone front, one broad carved lintel and bay window front. Row 2 Hearthward: warmer worn stone and oak, cozy amber windows, welcoming canopies or tiny inset balconies, carefully placed household plants and folded cloth, three distinct homely fronts. Row 3 Forgeward: sturdy charcoal and russet stone homes, copper ventilation flues, iron straps, warm inset windows, heavier practical lintels and three distinct arch/window arrangements; these are comfortable homes beside industry, not factories. Style: charming detailed hand-painted fantasy game art with clean dark outlines, weighty readable stone and warm wood, restrained brass and teal, soft amber interior light, matte volume. Keep every exterior prop within its cell and close to its building. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the nine separate silhouettes. No people, no labels, no lettering, no grid lines, no floor patches, no shadows extending across gutters, no watermark. Render a high-resolution usable atlas, not a concept page.
prompts.civic_fronts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent production sprite atlas with THREE distinct original public building frontages for The Stellar Holds, a painted 2D Dwarven mountain-hold game. Landscape canvas divided into three equal vertical cells with wide transparent gutters. Each frontage fully visible, tall proportions (width about two thirds of height), front-facing slightly elevated orthographic camera, level horizontal threshold at bottom center, no diagonal/isometric slant. They are carved into a subterranean hold, thick load-bearing stone, recessed doors, flat heavy stone coping, no sky, outdoor roofs or grass. LEFT: the Survey Office, dignified pale stone chart hall with a small brass armillary sphere seated within a central recessed upper arch, celestial bearings carved in lintel, two tall narrow amber archive windows and a sturdy ordinary oak entrance; unmistakably a place for maps and measurement. CENTER: the Foreman's Office, lower and broader practical shift hall, heavy granite pilasters, square recessed doorway, an enclosed upper clerks' window behind a broad timber ledge, restrained brass clock above door, small mounted shift slate beside entrance, iron-bound lintels, warm wood; no lettering on slate. RIGHT: the Practice Bay, a sturdy fortified training hall with broad chamfered arch, relief of crossed hammer and shield above the entrance, two shallow training-weapon niches integrated into its stone front, dark iron straps, red-brown masonry and warm lamps; entirely different from a royal palace or an office. Same art family across all three: weighty illustrated fantasy, warm dark contours, carved stone and oak, restrained brass/teal, matte highlights, readable at 300 game pixels wide. Actual transparent alpha outside each separate silhouette. No people, no labels or text, no scenery, no floor tiles, no ground shadows extending outside silhouettes, no watermark. Clear centered doors fit existing game threshold anchors.
